_comment: Mayan-language books (#6559). IA language codes (myn yua quc cak tzo tzh kek mam) + subjects (Maya/Quiché/Cakchikel/Tzotzil/Tzeltal/Kekchi/Mam/Pokonchi/Chol/Huastec language, Maya literature) -> 378 items -> 229 editions after holdings/dupe filter -> hand selection of grammars, dictionaries, devotional/sermon texts, colonial MSS and a few decipherment classics. Dropped: Gage travels (12 eds), Brinton LAAL series (Maya vols held), printing manuals, archaeology without language content. Decipherment-history scope belongs to #5653; only works not held were taken.
